regions.region: title, author block, abstract and introductory prose
regions.finding: The real article title and DOI were confirmed. The prose describes the current synthesis goals and cites earlier thailandepsin syntheses; citations are context, not current experiments.
Structures of previously known thailandepsins A-F and FK228; retained as prior-work source context rather than current synthesis records.
Literature-context reduction of a generic thailandepsin disulfide to the active thiol; recorded as a literature example, not a current-paper preparative experiment.

unresolved: Scheme 1 omits reducing agent, yield, and exact R/R' identities; classification is necessarily partial.

regions.finding: Retrosynthetic disconnections for 8/9 and 10/11/12/13. They are generic planning relations and are not counted as specific preparative experiments.
Rhodium/Josiphos/PPTS-catalyzed hydroamination of benzophenone imine 14 and hepta-1,2-diene 15 to directly used adduct 16 at 80 °C for 18 h in 0.1 M DCE.
Separate Fmoc and Cbz protection branches give 17 (73%, 96% ee) and 18 (58%). The 0 °C-to-room-temperature program is split into a cold start and warming stage; the source gives only a combined 17 h.

regions.region: Scheme 4 steps c-e and accompanying prose
regions.finding: Fmoc/Cbz dihydroxylations are separate experiments (79%/91%); periodate cleavage plus chlorite oxidation are separate two-step sequences to 19/20 (70%/82%). Unnumbered diols are retained as unresolved intermediates.

unresolved: No SI was supplied; most reagent charges, temperatures for c-e, yield measurement bases, and ee method are absent from the main text.
Compact protected intermediates were not forced into complete stereochemical SMILES.

regions.finding: Two specific arrows were recorded: EDCI/HOBt/NEt3 coupling of 19 and 21 to 22 (76%), then TFA/Et3SiH cleavage to 12 (81%).

The 23-to-24 TBS protection in footnote a is one experiment. All five hydrooxycarbonylation optimization rows are independent records with time, catalyst/ligand loading, combined isolated yield and 1H-NMR d.r.
For (R,R)-DIOP, the newly formed major allylic-ester center of 26 is assigned S by Mosher ester comparison. The source does not assign the minor diastereomer absolutely.

Steps a-c are one source-reported three-step sequence from 26 to 27 with 58% overall yield; steps d-f are separate Jones oxidation, Fmoc deprotection and macrolactamization records. The 58% was not relabeled as a step-c yield.
